conviction_note: The company-level evidence is the Q2 release and call: profits turning, BBM guided up to +20-25%, Gap China same-store sales 'even stronger' in Q3 to date. That is public and inside the guide. Against it sit platform and macro read-throughs that arrived after the company last spoke: Alibaba CMR -5% (Nov 19), JD Retail +2.9% and a profit miss (Nov 17), Singles' Day GMV +4.8% (pure e-commerce +3.7%), and October clothing retail -2.0%. The stock has already fallen 19% in five sessions on rising volume, which looks like it has priced most of the read-through. The findings net to about -0.6 (impact_sum). The scaled number leans slightly up (p_up 53 on an 8% absolute move, so +0.5) because the bar was cut by the drawdown and the name paid +7% for a profit beat last quarter. The two measurements disagree in sign because the findings are mostly macro proxies, each sized small, while p_up carries the positioning. That gap is information.
bar: Unsourced or disputed, so every finding is capped small. The only explicit Q3 2026 revenue estimate is a single figure of '2.38B' with ambiguous units (pro.stockalarm.io, https://pro.stockalarm.io/quote/BZUN/analysts), probably RMB2.38bn, which would be +10% y/y on Q3 2025's RMB2,156.2m (https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/baozun-announces-third-quarter-2025-unaudited-financial-results-302625467.html). No EPS consensus was found. Company guidance covers only full-year BBM top-line growth of +20-25% (raised on 2026-08-27; https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262136778-tradingkey) and a 2028 non-GAAP operating profit target of at least RMB700m. Q2 2026 revenue of RMB2.74bn missed a RMB2.77bn consensus slightly, while adjusted EPS beat (https://finviz.com/news/386166/baozun-shares-rise-as-earnings-beat-forecasts-and-profitability-improves).
positioning_check: Short interest is not crowded: 612.31K shares short at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 2.7 days to cover (massive.com, https://massive.com/quote/bzun). Equibles shows about 617K shares, 4.5 days to cover, as of 2026-10-05 (https://equibles.com/stocks/bzun/summary). The latest float figure is 2.08% (MarketBeat, May 2026). No usable option chain (baseline options.status empty_chain), so there is no skew and no implied move. Tape: -18.97% over 5 days, -22.31% over 20 days. Volume on Nov 20 was 681,739 shares on a -7.04% day, against a 20-day average of 245,735 (https://www.quiverquant.com/stock/BZUN/historical-prices/). A US$10m buyback was authorized on 2026-09-24. Reaction history, rebuilt from Quiver closes because the baseline history is empty: Q3'25 (2025-11-25 bmo) -5.8%; Q4'25 (2026-03-25) +16.4%, fully reversed the next day; Q2'26 (2026-08-27 bmo) +7.1%. Q1'26 (late May) was a few percent either way; the date is not pinned.

findings.finding: At the 2026-08-27 Q2 call management raised FY2026 BBM top-line guidance to +20-25% (from 15-20%). It said Gap China's Q3 quarter-to-date same-store sales trend was 'even stronger' than Q2's 20%+ range, with month-over-month improvement in July and August. On Q3 2025 BBM revenue of RMB396.0m, that implies Q3 2026 BBM of roughly RMB475-495m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 BBM +21.9% with raised BBM guidance: the stock closed +7.1% (2.82 to 3.02), but that print also carried a profit beat. No clean history for BBM alone.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: this is inside what the company guided, and it was said publicly three months ago. What is left is whether Q3 BBM lands at the top of the range. If the market were pricing BBM acceleration it would not have sold the stock 19% in a week on platform read-throughs that do not touch Gap stores.
findings.independence: Same document as the Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/386042/baozun-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results). The independent support is Gap Inc.'s finding below, a different source.

findings.finding: Gap Inc. reported Q3 FY2026 on 2026-11-19: Gap brand global comparable sales +9% (against +7% a year earlier), a 12th straight positive quarter. That supports brand heat for the Gap China business Baozun runs, though Gap China is not in Gap Inc.'s comps.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable. This is a proxy read-through, not a Baozun line.
findings.why_not_priced: It landed after Baozun last spoke. BZUN fell 7% on Nov 19 and 7% on Nov 20, the opposite of what a market reading this through would do. It is still a proxy: Gap China's comps are driven locally by Baozun.
findings.independence: Proxy only. It agrees directionally with management's Q3 QTD comment (tradingkey transcript, a different source).

findings.finding: Platform read-through for Baozun E-commerce (BEC, about 80% of revenue). Alibaba's September 2026 quarter (Nov 19) showed customer management revenue -5% y/y (+1% excluding a contra-revenue program). JD's Q3 2026 (Nov 17) showed JD Retail revenue +2.9% and a profit miss 'amid China's consumer slowdown'. Brand merchants' spend on Tmall and JD services was soft in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 BEC revenue +4.6% with product sales -9.6%. Total revenue missed consensus by about 1%, but the stock rose 7.1% on profit, so the revenue line has not been punished recently.
findings.why_not_priced: Probably mostly priced: BZUN fell 7.0% on Nov 19 and 7.0% on Nov 20 on 2.8x average volume, right after these two prints. What may remain is a BEC services revenue line below a bar set before them. At the Q2 call management said it had 'not seen any significant shifts in spending budgets of brand partners'.
findings.independence: JD: https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3374767/jdcom-misses-profit-expectations-amid-chinas-consumer-slowdown (a different company and document). Both are proxies; neither is a Baozun counterparty disclosure.

findings.finding: Singles' Day 2026, which sets the Q4 tone the call will describe: Syntun puts GMV at RMB1,776.4bn, +4.8% y/y, against +14.2% in 2025. Pure e-commerce platforms (Tmall, JD, Douyin) grew +3.7% against +12.3%, though the 2025 event ran five days longer. At the Q2 call management had said it expected 'a very strong finish in the coming Double 11'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baozun gives no quarterly guidance. In 2022 it disclosed a record 11.11 GMV and rose about 7% pre-market (https://m.gelonghui.com/live/833706), so 11.11 commentary has moved the stock before. No 2026 Baozun 11.11 disclosure was found.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since Nov 12. It is partly priced in the drawdown, but the 18% fall came on Nov 17-20, when the peer prints landed, not on Nov 12-13 (3.60 to 3.49). If the Q4 commentary on the call is cautious, the weak festival becomes a company statement.
findings.independence: The NBS October data (next finding) points the same way from a different source. A different Singles' Day summary: https://www.emarketer.com/content/price-wars-cautious-subdued-singles-day-2026 (fetch refused, title only).

findings.finding: NBS, 2026-11-17: October retail sales +0.4% y/y (consensus +0.8%). Clothes, shoes, hats and textiles -2.0% in October. Online clothing slowed from +3.4% YTD through September to +1.8% YTD through October, which implies October online clothing fell outright. That is the core category for both BBM (Gap, Hunter) and BEC apparel clients going into Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable for macro data on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public macro and partly in the drawdown. What remains is whether management's Q4 remarks on Gap same-store sales and BEC apparel acknowledge an October slowdown that sits against its August 'further improvements' language.
findings.independence: This is a proxy. It shares the Q4 consumption theme with the Singles' Day finding, but the source and series differ.

findings.finding: The profit trajectory sets an easy comparison. Q3 2025 had a non-GAAP operating loss of RMB10.8m and BEC adjusted operating income of RMB28.1m. Q2 2026 showed GAAP operating income of RMB63.4m against a loss of RMB9.4m a year earlier, BEC non-GAAP operating income of RMB107m (a Q2 high since 2022) and a narrowing BBM loss. Management raised the 2028 non-GAAP operating profit target to at least RMB700m. A Q3 swing to non-GAAP operating profit is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 profit beat with a slight revenue miss: +7.1% close to close. Q4'25 (2026-03-25): +16.4%, then fully reversed. Q3'25, when the operating loss narrowed but the net loss widened to RMB107.1m: -5.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: The trend is public, but the stock now trades below where it was before the Q2 profit beat (2.82, the same as the Aug 26 close), so the 18% fall erased the post-Q2 re-rating. If the profit trajectory were priced, the stock would not be back at its pre-Q2 level after a quarter the company described as accelerating.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 comparison base: https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/baozun-announces-third-quarter-2025-unaudited-financial-results-302625467.html. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: BEC product sales are a structural drag on the revenue line: -9.6% y/y in Q2 2026 (Home & Furnishing, Cosmetics), and Q2 total revenue already missed consensus by about 1% (RMB2.74bn against RMB2.77bn). With the only Q3 estimate implying about +10% y/y against Q2's +7.5%, the headline revenue could miss again.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2'26 revenue miss came with a profit beat and the stock rose 7.1%. The revenue line has not been punished on its own recently.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar is thin and unverified (one estimate of ambiguous units), so a miss against a stale single estimate is plausible, but the market has not paid for this line. It is capped small.

findings.finding: A US$10m buyback was authorized on 2026-09-24 for 12 months. That is roughly 6% of a market cap near US$170m at a US$2.82 ADS price (estimated, not sourced). The stock is now at its pre-Q2 level, and the call may disclose execution and support it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. This is the first buyback in the window studied.
findings.why_not_priced: The authorization is public. Execution is not (no HKEX repurchase return for Oct or Nov was found). If execution were visible, the 19% drawdown on 2.8x volume would have met a disclosed bid.

baseline_tension: There is no skew and no implied move to agree or disagree with. The negative findings (platform, Singles' Day, macro) agree with the -19% 5-day run-up and are probably largely priced by it. The positive company-level trend cuts against the run-up and is why p_up sits slightly above 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6 (inside the guide): the BBM momentum finding lands inside the raised FY BBM guide and an already public Q3 QTD comment, so it went from +0.5 to +0.3.

Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown and positioning are worth 0): the draft positioning finding (+0.8, 'the drawdown lowered the bar') was recast as the sourced buyback (capital_return) and cut to +0.4; the drawdown now acts only through p_up, which went from 55 to 53.

Lesson 5 (proxies small): the Alibaba/JD read-through went from -0.8 to -0.6, because Alibaba's CMR decline is mostly a contra-revenue program (+1% excluding it) and neither print is a Baozun counterparty disclosure.
Lesson 6 (unsourced bar): every finding was already capped under 1 point; nothing further changed.
Left standing: the Singles' Day, NBS, profit trajectory and revenue-drag findings.
